title: April Kelleher
summary: The civilian survivor at the center of Broken Dawn, whose research trail connects New York, Ann Arbor and a source-specific Washington handoff to Alani Kelso.

claims.text: Ubisoft's Broken Dawn overview identifies April Kelleher as the novel's civilian protagonist and links her to its Division Agent team.
In the novel's source-specific story, April follows a research lead from New York to Ann Arbor and delivers the resulting intelligence to Alani Kelso in Washington.

paragraphs.text: April is the civilian point of view in the official novel's published premise. Her trail creates the narrative reason for an SHD team to leave New York and pursue a possible antiviral lead.

Broken Dawn's later source-specific sequence lets April transfer the research lead to Alani Kelso in Washington. It is a transmedia connection, not evidence that the novel's events are a playable Division 2 mission.

verification.notes: Licensed-novel record. Plot is summarized independently and classified as major spoiler.
